theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgi_tangent_measure
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U E : Set (Rn (n + 1))) (μ : Measure (Rn (n + 1))) (ν : Rn (n + 1) → Rn (n + 1)), IsOpen U → NullMeasurableSet E volume → IsGaussGreenPair U E μ ν → ∀ x ∈ reducedBoundary U μ ν, HasApproxTangentPlaneWithMultiplicity n μ x ((Submodule.span ℝ {reducedNormal μ ν x})ᗮ) 1
